{{Quote|Mythra... that is a valuable metal. I suggest keeping that close to you. There are often... unsavory... parties looking for Mythra.|Altuur zok Adon|<ref name="Mythran Chestplate">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=item|Mythran Chestplate}}</ref>}}
'''Mythra''' was a type of precious metal, valued at 12-18 credits per gram. It was sometimes sought after by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. In the year [[3626 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|6.3}}</ref> [[Altuur zok Adon]] commented on the metal's value when armor pieces made of Mythra were acquired by the [[Alliance Commander]].<ref name="Mythran Chestplate" />
